title: The Bus with a Book in Its Belly
synopsis: The six friends take Ben's cloth-wrapped book on the green bus to Market Street, where the librarian keeps it safe overnight for Sunday.
continuity_state: Before: Saturday follows Friday rehearsal. Ben has his intact book in a cloth bag at home. The six friends have already visited Market Street previously, and the library is by the real clock and bakery. After: All six friends and their grown-ups take the established green bus west from its stop beyond Far Meadow. Ben hands the blue six-page book to the librarian, who stores it on a staff shelf Saturday night for the Sunday reading table; its cloth bag returns home with Ben. No extra page or bus ticket is added, no alternate route is invented, and all children return home.
